entities.summary: Bruno Alexandre Dias Coelho is a Portuguese futsal player who plays as a winger for FF Napoli, and for the Portugal national team. Coelho scored Portugal's winning goal in UEFA Futsal Euro 2018 final. He also has over 100 caps.
